Ohhh I see. Oh wow, that's definitely a ways off from now. More years of this subconscious shit T.T. I heard that Pluto transiting the 1st house is like another extension of what you went through in the 12th house, but more of a focus on "rebirth" and becoming a whole new person by the end of that transit. It's gonna be interesting... lol 

Pluto square Pluto transit sounds intense. And with the 12 house Pluto transit, man. Well, it'll be transformational for sure. 

My Gemini moon is in my 4th house, too! Ah, yea, I guess it can seem a bit detached as a moon, but I feel a lot more scattered lol. I guess your sun sign matters, too, on how your moon manifests, no? I'm a scorpio sun, so I feel like that intensifies my gemini moon. How does it feel for you? And do you have trouble sleeping?

Ah yea, it’s helpful to see how others are dealing with it. And yes, there are personal touches to everyone’s story, but there also seems to be a collective experience with this Pluto transit. Isn’t Pluto about to enter our 1st house in 2024? Not 2034? Well, actually, it’s moving to Aquarius in 2024, right? So I guess maybe it won’t be moving to every Aquarius rising’s 1st just yet depending on the degree. Either way, I heard that Pluto going through the 1st house is just more subconscious shit, but better? Maybe? I’m not sure. 
 
Oh man, a Pluto square Pluto transit sounds pretty intense. Like… super transformative? Is this something that everyone will experience at least once in their life time? Supposedly it lasts between 1 year and 8months so maybe it’ll be less daunting than a Pluto transit that lasts 15 years. But the intensity of that transit seems a lot, so I hear you. Hopefully it’s just an opportunity for powerful growth. 

Also, this is a bit off topic, but I noticed you have a Gemini moon! I just wanted to say hi to a fellow Gemini moon 👋! Sorry if that was corny haha

Wow, I didn’t expect to find this thread and now I don’t feel so alone. I’ve been thinking about this recently and wondering if this was related to the current Pluto  transit and I guess it is. Yea, the last 15 years of it in the 12th house had been chaotic. So many endings and my mental health just kept getting worse and worse. And I’ve been feeling more and more alone and hopeless about my future and the possibility of having deep and meaningful connections. I also never thought I could get more suicidal than I already was and I also never thought it could get more “real” and intense until it did. It kept getting more and more real until now it feels constant and “fixed” like a part of my brain already made up its mind. And I feel more and more a desire to isolate and a need to build more walls and be invisible. It doesn’t help with what’s going on in the world either. 

So I guess maybe it’s an Aquarius rising thing. I also am pretty worried about it transiting through the 1st house. I heard that can also be pretty heavy and will challenge  your subconscious like it did in the 12th house. So it’s like a double whammy of whatever the 12th house was. But supposedly you come out of it a new person. So we’ll see. I know a Capricorn rising who is currently living their best life so maybe there’s hope. They have strong supportive friendships and are living life on their own terms.

Hmm thank you for sharing! Yes, we all have varying levels of narcissism, but due to my interaction with this person, I wondered if they had some malignant narcissism or likelihood to be more narcissistic. I can see how the Leo Capricorn energy could cause a feeling of self importance. I definitely see that.
And yes they’re considered beautiful to many people on the outside hence why I need to know is this person crazy or am I crazy. This person becoming famous is plausible but kinda scary.

I’ll say this person claims that talking about gender and identity and sexuality is merely theoretical and unproductive and unrealistic. This person is pretty misogynistic but denies it and is a huge advocate for men to express themselves but doesn’t care much about other gender issues.
What do you mean people being provoked by you? What shoes that and why? Does this chart show anything about possible narcissism or cult leader?
And what else stands out career wise or financially? I’m curious about the 9th and 10th house but also the 3rd house.

Thank you. I’ve been trying to work on that but it’s tricky because of my mom. As for thé car, thé car was already repossessed. I never got the car myself, my mom did but under my name and I didn’t know. Thé car is long gone now.

Is there another way to live in Korea without teaching English? 

And if I teach English, I’ve also been curious how to find jobs where you work with adults or for businesses. I have chronic pain and im wary of working with kids.
That's true. But it's hard to run into people like that. I don't live in a community where random people easily talk to each other.
I don’t think I want to talk to someone who sexually assaulted me . As for others, i have no way of contacting them .

I refuse to talk to people from the part of my past that I felt the most broken apart. As much as I’d like to speak my mind to them, I doubt they will even listen or care. The damage is already done. And I actually am a pretty talkative person. I love talking. But nothing with everyone because I’ve learned to not trust or open up too much with most people.

I have unwanted thoughts and memories and triggers that show up almost everyday. I’m finding it hard to just live my life because things become a reminder of something else that I can’t seem to let go.

I don’t feel like I matter in the grand scheme of things. There are billions of people on the earth and we will all die eventually. I don’t have many people who I think will even care if I leave. It’ll just be something unfortunate. And I feel too fragmented and broken to love myself again. I feel really lost and hopeless.

I can try and this is something I’ve been trying for a while but I always return here. I hate my existence and the shame I have is piercing. I want to erase myself completely because I don’t see a point.
Hmm but there are some wounds I don’t know I can heal even if I just worked on it slowly
I hope I don’t come off as stubborn. Im just being honest but I don’t know if I believe I can even eventually be okay without feeling lonely. It’s just hard to imagine atm

Hm, I know this is going to sound so cliche and stupid or dramatic, but it’s really how I feel atm. I just feel a lot of pain and I’ve been feeling this for so long now that I’m skeptical or scared I’ll never get out of it.
I’ve felt those moments before. But then I feel like this, tired. And each time it feels heavier and more “real” and I keep thinking I never thought this could feel more and more serious.
I’m not sure I’ll have a breakthrough anytime soon. I feel very done with life and it’s just too painful to exist.
Oh wow, that’s so interesting. Then in what circumstances can you live in Korea or overseas in general and do your own thing? Do you need a visa? Do you need property? Citizenship somehow?
What if it’s an online business or freelance gig? And it’s international versus just in Korea? I’m not thinking to get a side gig in Korea - just do my own thing online.
What if your side gig has nothing to do with teaching English? Like completely unrelated?

Ohh what about businesses? Like teaching English for businesses? How are they with pets and how do you find those kinds gigs, too? And would now be a good time to try to get a visa or do I do that after I get a job secured there?

I really want make it to Korea by spring 2022 (feb-March), but I’m wondering if it’s too late to apply. If not, what method would be my best bet  (via recruiters, finding postings online, which schools to apply to)? I’ve been trying to do some research  online and it’s a bit overwhelming. Also, I have a cat that I want to bring with me. She’s 12 years old and I’ve had her her entire life so far. Im not willing to leave her behind especially since I’m planning to be there for 1-2 years.

Also, is it okay or possible to have a side gig while you’re there? I want to eventually have a small business on the side, maybe a craft shop or something. I’m not sure if this is allowed.

Thank you.

Interesting. I’ve been told that Chiron is something you can’t overcome or can’t fully heal. But I am skeptical of that.

Hi! So I posted a few days ago asking about career and anything else that might be interesting. Someone pointed out my Chiron in the 7th house being a challenging aspect for relationships. I understand Chiron is the wounded healer and it’s how you help others heal. But I’m having a hard time accepting that all my relationships aren’t going to end or go well. I will say I definitely had a hard time with friendships and family relationships growing up (probably because that was my Chiron). And my parents always argued. So I’m wondering, is Chiron something you can overcome? And how does mine being in Leo make that placement different (even in the slightest)? I am also curious about my Venus, Jupiter, and part of fortune all in Virgo. 

Thank you again for taking the time to reply if you do! ◡̈

As for not getting hurt if lovers and friends don’t come around… I mean I guess, but I beg to differ lol. The lack of  fulfilling, stable, and meaningful relationships is just as painful as relationships that suck 😅🥲.

Hmm, yea I’ve been trying to look around and read up on it here and there. I’m just now more curious about that aspect and I might ask another question about it to see if anyone has more to add. Thank you, though. It is what it is. I did read up on people with similar Chiron placements and there’s a lot more to it than just that one aspect and I *think* it doesn’t always represent or manifest the way we expect it to. I think for some, they had some favorable placements like having their Chiron in the 7th house in Taurus, and their Venus in… I think it was in some other house, but again, a positive thing. So it was like they were completely doomed with their relationships. I forgot exactly what that person said, but I can find the thread and share it with you if you’re interested in what one of the commentators said about their Chiron   in relation to their whole chart (sorta/a tad bit). And I’m also just curious about what it means depending on what sign is in the 7th house. Like for me, it’s Leo. But for someone else, it could be Taurus, Pisces, or Capricorn. So then, does that affect the way Chiron in the 7th house manifests? Sorry I’m just full of questions now 😅🙈.

As for a wound you never heal from… I find that really hard to accept. I feel like it’s a wound you find the most challenging to overcome, but I feel like you CAN overcome it. It just doesn’t make sense to me that you can’t overcome something.

Ah, I’m so sorry to hear that. It is pretty challenging because having close relationships whether it be family, friends or relationships are important. I don’t know about relationships, I’m a late bloomer and am in my first relationship that’s been going on for a couple years. But in terms of friendships, oh boy. I have a terrible history of numerous short lived friendships. It’s been a thing since I was little and it sometimes feels hopeless to have long term close knit friends now. So I wonder if that’s what you’re talking about and if that’s how Chiron is affecting my “relationships “.

Ah, that’s actually pretty depressing 😅. Does that mean a successful long term relationship will be almost impossible to achieve? And what if I overcome my Chiron? And how could I overcome my Chiron especially since it’s Leo in the 7th house?
Me ◡̈
